title: Wildberries Warehouse Disruption Spread Across Seven Regions
subtitle: Several facilities were destroyed or disabled, while other sites remained partly operational or had disputed damage reports.

source.name: Reuters, Kommersant, local emergency reports and company statements

data.label: Ryazan
data.detail: Reporting differed on whether half or all of the facility was lost.

data.label: Perm
data.detail: Initial reports said the site was disabled; Reuters later reported operations continued.

data.label: Udmurtia
data.detail: The Sarapul-area facility was reported destroyed by fire after an attack.

data.label: Penza
data.detail: The regional fulfillment center was reported destroyed.

data.label: Tambov
data.detail: Interior footage suggested major damage, but the site remained operational.

data.label: Samara
data.detail: Reuters reported 160,000 of 180,000 m² burned at the site.

supportingFacts.label: Warehouse area reported targeted in one compiled assessment.
Area reported unusable in the same assessment.
Estimated share of Wildberries capacity affected.
Company rhetoric described mass attacks; official reporting described a much smaller debris fire.

metadata.keyFinding: Wildberries logistics disruption became a multi-region network problem rather than a single-site incident.
